title: Shrimp and Quinoa Bowls
seoTitle: Shrimp and Quinoa Bowls | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Charred shrimp skewers over quinoa with roasted vegetables
subtitle: Charred shrimp skewers over quinoa with roasted vegetables
description: Large shrimp marinate in lemon-garlic oil, grill on skewers, and serve over quinoa with roasted zucchini and cherry tomatoes.

steps.title: Cook quinoa
steps.instruction: Simmer quinoa in 4 cups water 15 minutes until tails appear and grains are tender but not mushy. Fluff with fork and season lightly.

steps.title: Roast vegetables
steps.instruction: Toss zucchini and tomatoes with 2 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper. Roast at 425°F 18–20 minutes until zucchini tender and tomatoes burst.

steps.title: Marinate shrimp
steps.instruction: Toss shrimp with remaining oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper. Marinate 15 minutes while vegetables roast.

steps.title: Grill shrimp skewers
steps.instruction: Thread shrimp on skewers. Grill over medium-high 2 minutes per side until pink, opaque, and lightly charred—not curled tight or rubbery.

steps.title: Assemble bowls
steps.instruction: Portion quinoa, roasted veg, and shrimp skewers. Top with feta and parsley. Shrimp should snap cleanly when bitten.

proTips: Pat shrimp dry before marinating—wet shrimp will not char.
Offer tahini drizzle for crews who want creamy richness.
Metal skewers skip soaking and speed up prep.
leftovers: Chop into a cold quinoa salad next day.
Shrimp do not reheat well—plan portions carefully.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Light but protein-heavy. Grill marks make it feel like a cookout even on a Tuesday shift.
mealPrepNotes: Soak wooden skewers 30 minutes. Cook quinoa ahead—it holds well. Station: Thread shrimp uniform for even grill timing—3 per skewer works well. Station: Grill shrimp 2 minutes per side max—overcooked shrimp ruin the bowl. Station: Bowl line: quinoa, veg, shrimp, lemon wedge, feta optional.
